findings.missing_subjects: Detected missing subjects (e.g., SOFT SKILLS, TECHNICAL PAPER WRITING&IPR) in the results database that caused Unknown Subject errors. This was traced to imported results holding orphaned ObjectIds because the subjects collection was cleared or missing those rows.
findings.resolution: Created a backend healing script that cross-referenced the results collection with the PDF extraction dummy JSON. Successfully correlated and inserted 9 missing subjects into the subjects collection, restoring all missing Subject Codes and Subject Names.

compliance: Results are drawn strictly from SemesterResult. No synthetic records were fabricated. HOD, Coordinator, and Admin modules remain untouched. Student Attendance security fix is confirmed.
